newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy nearby offers up, corn steady.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soy nearby offers up, corn steady.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers for the nearby positions of July and August rose four cents a bushel while corn values were unchanged, dealers said.
Soybeans for nearby shipment are scarce, which has put pressure on the premium, one U.S. exporter said.
Soft red winter slipped one cent a bushel and hard red winter wheat basis values were steady. Export demand for soft wheat was lackluster, one dealer said.
In export news, Egypt decreed it will require imports of commodities meant for human consumption to be accompanied by proof that genetic engineering was not used in their production.
Traders and industry sources in Egypt this week obtained the decree dated July 1. It was provided to Reuters on Thursday.
